Name: ClosetOtakuChu's Slime Plushies for Alternative Textures
Author: TerraTerraCotta
Description:
Part of a self-imposed effort to help convert older, depreciated, and abandoned retexture mods for modern use in Alternative Textures!

This is an Alternative Textures conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7300]ClosetOtakuChu's Slime Plushies!

[/url]A sticky'd post by the mod author indicates it's not easy to maintain and free to use. So I figured this especially deserves a new lease on life.
The only tweak I provided was adjusting the position of the yellow slime plush to better match the others. 

[b]Items Available for this Texture:[/b]
[i]-Decorative Bowl
-Futan Bear
-Futan Rabbit
-Small Junimo Plush
-Squirrel Figure
-Table Plant[/i]


This Mod has been tested beforehand and should work so long as Alternative Textures Works.

[i][b]DISCLAIMER:[/b] If the original mod author wishes me to take this down, or wishes to update the original mod with the alternative texture pack I've created. They are welcome to DM me and I can accomodate. The sprites were created by ClosetOtakuChu, all I did was format them and set them up for Alternative Textures Use. This effort only exists to make older mods more accessible to modern versions of Stardew Valley.
[/i]
